case_for: The best coverage grade on the roster (78.4), UTEP's No. 1 corner by headline grade, and the widest fits list in this book: 44 of 135 rooms cleared, including P4 rooms at Iowa State, South Carolina, Kentucky, Syracuse and Florida. Quarterbacks completed 29% of the throws they aimed at him.

His production cell is the best in this book: top-third G6 corners signed at 32% and appeared in games at 15% in the base classes. The corner pool's stickers are the strongest of any position here (eight in twenty, including Dee Alford and Decobie Durant, both now NFL starters) — and Alford, a 5-11 Tusculum corner who signed through the CFL, is the shape of his path. His 78.4 coverage grade and 29% completion rate allowed are the traits those signings were built on.
case_against: The sample is thin — 57 coverage snaps and 7 targets in 2026, after a 2025 season at Utah with no game action. His band's likely rung is the claim itself, and the claim currently rests on seven throws.

Seven targets. No interceptions, two breakups, and no verified speed on file for the position where the forty is the argument. The base rate describes corners with full seasons; his file is a fraction of one, and the market has no reference for him (DraftScout lists him only under a nickname, with no tier).
call.verdict_college: QUALIFIED — as a G6 starter — the grade, the completion rate allowed and 44 cleared rooms qualify the claim at this level. The thin sample is why the claim stops at this level rather than reaching for his all-conference ceiling.
call.verdict_pro: NOT QUALIFIED YET — the cell and the traits say this is the roster's most plausible future signing; the volume says the claim cannot be made yet. This is a file gap, not a performance disqualification — the performance, in its small sample, is the best on the team.
call.lever_college: Volume. A full 2027 season as the No. 1 corner — 300-plus coverage snaps at anything near this grade — turns a seven-target story into the book's strongest defensive file.
call.lever_pro: One full season at this grade with real target volume and his first interceptions, plus a verified forty at his pro day. That is the complete Alford/Durant profile, and it is all in front of him.
